english.title: Water undertaker fail ensure water discharge free from mud,silt or substances or pollution prejudicial to fish or spawn
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker, failed to take all necessary steps that water discharged by it under section 165 of the Water Industry Act 1991 was as free as may be reasonably practicable from mud and silt, solid, polluting offensive or injurious substances and any substances prejudicial to fish or spawn or to spawning beds or food of fish
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
